references.text: Repeats the title 'Lord of all the earth' in the same context regarding the ark of the covenant going before the people across the Jordan
Describes the Lord as 'Lord of all the earth', the same title used for the ark of the covenant
Prophesies about the Lord as 'Lord of all the earth' in an eschatological context
Refers to 'Lord of all the earth' in connection with the two anointed ones who stand before him
Refers to 'Lord of all the earth' in the vision of the four chariots
Describes the ark of the covenant as God's visible presence among the people
The ark of the covenant is carried before the people around Jericho, a similar function to that at the crossing of the Jordan
Declares that the earth and everything in it belongs to the Lord
Refers to 'Lord of all the earth' in connection with the two witnesses
